# Formship Games

> Formship Games is an independent game studio in Orlando, Florida, and the studio name of Formship LLC. It makes tactical and systemic games with hand-drawn art. Spare Knight, a tactical roguelike, is in development for desktop. Founder: Christian D'Albano.

## Pages

- [Home](https://formship.io/): the studio, its games and the people.
- [Games](https://formship.io/games/): all the games, with Spare Knight in development.
- [Spare Knight](https://formship.io/games/spare-knight): a tactical roguelike. Browser alpha playable; a desktop version aimed at Steam is in development.
- [I Won't Be Abducted](https://formship.io/games/i-wont-be-abducted): a tabletop defense game about a boy defending his bedroom from aliens. Released.
- [ThunderBashers](https://formship.io/games/thunderbashers): an arena brawler where spinning is the only verb, with online rooms. Released.
- [Studio](https://formship.io/studio): who works here and company details.
- [Privacy](https://formship.io/privacy)
- [Formship Games on itch.io](https://formship.itch.io): play the games in a browser.
